result.title: Curriculum Learning Teaches LLMs Long-Horizon Implicit Reasoning, Up To A Limit
result.summary: LLMs "reason" by externalizing intermediate steps as tokens through chain-of-thought (CoT), yet even frontier reasoning models hit abrupt performance cliffs on long-horizon tasks. Implicit reasoning (reasoning within a single forward pass) is useful during CoT generation, as the model can "search ahead" to decide the correct next move without explicit search. Models with weak implicit reasoning are more likely to commit to wrong paths and must attempt to recover via backtracking, while models with strong implicit reasoning identify the correct proof strategy directly, shortening the CoT. However, prior work shows LLMs struggle to reason implicitly beyond shallow depths, with no relief from scale. We investigate whether curriculum learning can extend this depth by fine-tuning on examples with progressively increasing vocabulary size and lookahead (the number of steps a model must search ahead to identify the correct next move). At matched compute, curriculum-trained models achieve lookaheads where no-curriculum training fails. Qwen3-0.6B reaches 98% accuracy on problems with lookahead up to 256 with curriculum, compared to 45% without. However, progress slows as fine-tuning continues, following a saturating exponential that suggests a maximum intrinsic lookahead to which models can learn to reason implicitly. Larger models reach higher fitted ceilings, fine-tuning pretrained models far outpaces training from scratch, and curriculum step sizes that are too large stall progression. Finally, the capability acquired on synthetic data transfers to natural language reasoning, with curriculum-trained models outperforming models trained without curriculum at matched compute on 11 natural language reasoning benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究课程学习能否扩展 LLM 的隐式推理（单次前向内「提前搜索」）深度：按逐步增大的词表规模与 lookahead 微调，发现匹配算力下课程训练可在无课程失败处成功，但进展趋于饱和指数，暗示存在内在最大 lookahead，更大模型与预训练起点上限更高，且能力可迁移到自然语言推理基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本的隐式/单次前向推理与 LVR 的 latent 状态生成高度同构，其 lookahead 上限、饱和曲线与课程步长过大会停滞等发现，可能为 latent 轨迹深度、训练监督与长度泛化提供可核查线索，但需在视觉多模态设定下另行验证。
